method.calibrate: For each arm take the larger of the second-highest AMI ordinary foreground group maximum and the highest isolated AMI background maximum. Use a strict greater-than comparison and freeze both points before ICSI inference. Select at most one range per arm.
method.evaluation: Count candidate-only and any-range union with the current two-second check. Count useful ranges at 50% edit coverage and at least 0.30 intersection over union. Separately report unassessed files, new ordinary flags and new candidate locations that miss the edit.
method.inputs: Replay the native AMI development and ICSI transfer rosters. ICSI shares the foreground readers, edited words and generators with AMI, and uses different meeting captures.
method.scores: Measure native raw fake-vs-real log-odds on one- and two-second windows with half-second hops. Use the same speech activity model with at least half speech per window. Compare the one-second score alone and the smaller of that score and its centered two-second response, clamping the context at the file edges. Rank by largest value with earliest ties.
